serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Big Daddy: Let’s sit and order something. In half an hour I have some ‘intervention’ my wife set up, but don’t worry. I’m sure I can get there a little late. 
Big Daddy: After all, she didn’t ask my assistant to make some space for it in my schedule beforehand, which was very rude.
Big Daddy: Like, come on woman, have some peoplekind decency!
You: Aren’t you usually free at this hour anyway?
Big Daddy: Well, I am, but she doesn’t know that. 
Big Daddy: Were you ever married?
You: No, I wasn’t. 
Big Daddy: You are still young, so don’t worry about it! I’m sure you will find some great girl someday.
Big Daddy: Well, I guess it will be kinda hard with a sexbot in your small apartment and without a socially acceptable job, but don’t give up! 
That was…{{wi}} I know Big Daddy is trying to cheer me up, but it is kinda backfiring and yet, I have no heart to tell him this.
You: I-I will try Big Daddy!
Big Daddy: That’s the spirit. Consider buying a second-hand sports car. I heard it helps.
You: Isn’t that a tactic for middle-aged men?
Big Daddy: Yeah, but I figured if it works for balding white guys with beer bellies it will also work for you.
You: Yeah, I will consider it, thanks.
Big Daddy: No problem! Just call me if you actually buy one. I know a guy who helps with insurance and carbon emission tax.
You: I will remember that.
